notes.title: Release date annouced！January 9, 2023！
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2095300/13/
Dear all:
We are glad to inform you that the official version of Breakout 13 will finally be released on January 9, 2023（GMT+8）! 

And the good news is the official version will support Chinese and English bilingual.

[previewyoutube=Xk3bUAnSm-Y;full][/previewyoutube]

We sincerely appreciate all of your support and waiting and we look forward to your attention as always. 
So, let’s meet at school on January 9, 2023 !
